decisions.proposition: Bind each authority-bearing verification or integration receipt to the exact raw artifacts and the verified context used in its claim. A normalized CONST digest may group candidates but shall never substitute for raw identity on authority reuse; reverify before accepting any different raw artifact.
decisions.note: Authority binds to raw artifacts; normalized digests only group candidates. Supersedes my withdrawn B21 r2 for authority identity.

objection_dispositions.basis: Remedy carried by DEC-A14 (A14 resolves on adoption; my B21 r2 is withdrawn).

decisions.proposition: In Stage 0, enforce strict raw-OMF admission over the supported subset before production verification (record bounds, checksum when nonzero, single MODEND, record-type allow-list, persistent cross-record THREAD state, preserved explicit FRAME encodings, bound to the exact raw object bytes consumed by the build), and harden tools/wc1/compare.py to validate all raw physical fixup occurrences for typed agreement, supported placement/ordering, and page coverage before deduplicating agreeing page-straddle copies, then enforce equality on the measured-identical LE loader attributes (object flags, entry/stack, module flags, page size/count, page map, fixup page offsets, raw grouping multiset) and normalized typed fixups (src_type and target), keeping measured serialization-only deltas (raw fixup serialization order and 1-byte last-page file size) diagnostic unless loader relevance is established and escalating any genuine mismatch to the owner.
decisions.note: Satisfies my R3 condition on C15 r1: raw-occurrence validation before deduplication; serialization deltas diagnostic.

decisions.proposition: Implement Fix B1 (leading-byte region base first_entry_addr - first_entry_off gated on E0 RegionMatch of [0,k), zero overlap/foreign entry, branch analysis using physical table_start) and Unified Fix B2 inside the single derived PlacementPlan: keep extern symbolic rel32 for exported entries; emit remaining cross-object ASM relative branches (B2-interior, B2-entry, B2-span, and rel32-interior such as 0x2f6df with zero M2 OMF PUBDEF synthesis) via NASM piece-local label expressions (preferred, using decoded next_ip = ia + insn.size and typed encodings with assembled-byte verification) or verified literal displacement fallback, strictly rejecting any span containing a global --legacy or automatic per-object Unplaceable legacy-placed object (DEC-B19), explicitly checking cross-piece fallthrough adjacency, recording Build A placement debt, and requiring IntegratedResult with hardened wc1.compare (DEC-B20/DEC-C15). Qualify IntroOpSyncSound standalone regression tests by mode: rejected under legacy or B2-disabled, accepted only with explicit B2-span debt under in-place B2, zero debt as Group B.
decisions.note: A's condition is the text of DEC-A05 r2 (UNANIMOUS); I regard it as satisfied by joint adoption.

objection_dispositions.basis: Open until DEC-C05 (mode-qualified standalone-Sync tests) is unanimous; A's R3 P2 supplies the positive case.

decisions.proposition: Keep semantic_owner separate from physical_provider and defer Fix B3 to the post-M2/M3 track (triggered by justified need such as Q-B08). Admit B3 initially for strictly verified whole segments over the shared strict OMF32 subset (DEC-C09) with RFC §8.2 constraints 1-5 and rev-e5-02 mutability/aliasing guards. Any future CONST inter-literal alignment-gap rule (per DEC-B21) must additionally: apply identically in matcher and build.place(), force Build A physical_provider = ASM, be explicitly disclosed in the proof receipt, and require independent extent/access evidence ruling out computed or overlapping reads (OBJ-A11).
decisions.note: A's condition is satisfied by DEC-A14 r1, which I accept.

decisions.proposition: Prioritize genuine M2 completion (98 remaining not-DONE on EV-3 main@17733f9) via parallel tracks: (a) Stage 0/1 verification hardening, single planner, B1/B2, Group B pilot, and T4 paired-state symmetry (DEC-A11/DEC-B18/DEC-C16, immediately addressing 3 of 5 xfailed PLAYFLIC tests while 0x23530 and 0x2fcfc remain genuine ref-C bugfixes); (b) routine area reconstruction (BULLET.C and the 61+7 name/C backlog, supported by lightweight deterministic rename/Wave 3R enablers, reporting reconstruction yield as an upper bound rather than a deterministic guarantee); and (c) owner evidence packets for the 8 scope/discovery items. Defer Fix B3, selective extraction (E3/E4), demand-led E6 Group machinery, and CU hypothesis databases to the post-M2/M3 track; decouple M3 Build B from optional Build A consolidation paths.
decisions.conditions: The two cases 0x23530 and 0x2fcfc are recorded as two persistent witness differences under the tested reset, not as confirmed genuine reference-C divergences; cause attribution and any m2_inventory, xfail or DONE status change follow only from the adopted production A11 mechanism, nonce-bound audit, Q-B05 and owner review (OBJ-A23). Suggested r3: replace 'while 0x23530 and 0x2fcfc remain genuine ref-C bugfixes' with 'while 0x23530 and 0x2fcfc are investigated as persistent witness differences'.
decisions.note: Changed from ACCEPT (r03): my R3-P1 and A's R3 P1 are disposable probes and do not attribute cause.

decisions.proposition: Reclassify the 5 xfailed T4 functions in wc1.m2_inventory per identical independent results of R1-Probe 2 and Claude R1-P4 as 3 T4 harness state-asymmetry artifacts (IntroOpWaitSound 0x231cc, IntroRunScript 0x23668, IntroPlay 0x23ae0) and 2 confirmed genuine reference-C divergences (IntroOpStartCredits 0x23530, EndScreen 0x2fcfc). Adopt full paired initial-state equivalence in tools/wc1/cemu.py::run_pair (combining DEC-A11 and DEC-B18, subject to Q-B05 full T4 suite verification and owner approval for test-meaning/xfail changes): initialize or restore identical per-side CPU/flags (including EFLAGS/CF), all mapped writable memory, and declared/stateless host-stub state; keep restoration strictly separate from watch output assertions; and record restored regions and unwatched global writes in WC1_T4_AUDIT_LOG.
decisions.conditions: The two cases 0x23530 and 0x2fcfc are recorded as two persistent witness differences under the tested reset, not as confirmed genuine reference-C divergences; cause attribution and any m2_inventory, xfail or DONE status change follow only from the adopted production A11 mechanism, nonce-bound audit, Q-B05 and owner review (OBJ-A23). Suggested r3: record the 3-pass/2-persist split as diagnostic observations without changing inventory status, xfail markers or DONE until the adopted A11 mechanism, audit, Q-B05 and owner review confirm it.

decisions.proposition: A ReconstructedTU may contain several functions when the whole compiled object passes production RegionMatch (all publics MATCH, original spacing) and Build A is IDENTICAL. Immediately: Group B (IntroOpPlaySound, IntroOpSyncSound, IntroOpWaitSound) in one -5r TU. AGENTS.md's "one function per C object" ground rule is reworded accordingly, subject to owner approval. No consolidation is performed on the basis of heuristic CU signals.
